description: Resource attributes for event resources. Populated by ResourceDescriptors.Event.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant identifier. Used by islamuevent_tenant_admin derived role.

eventId.description: Event identifier. Used by event-role derived roles to look up principal's event assignments.

userId.description: Owning user identifier for events published under a user actor.

organizationId.description: Owning organization identifier. Used by islamuevent_org_admin derived role.

authorizationPhase.description: Authorization phase marker. Event create checks use pre_create before an actor or event ID exists.

groupId.description: Owning group identifier for pre-create event requests. Publisher permissions are enforced by the handler.

provenanceType.description: Normalized event provenance code or stable lookup identifier.

organizerActorId.description: Verified organizer authority actor when one has been established.

organizerUserId.description: Verified organizer's user identifier, supplied only by server-side event loading.

organizerOrganizationId.description: Verified organizer's organization identifier, supplied only by server-side event loading.

organizerGroupId.description: Verified organizer's group identifier, supplied only by server-side event loading.

submittedByUserId.description: User that originally submitted a community-reported event when retained.

organizerVerificationStatus.description: Optional normalized organizer verification state when an authoritative source exists.
